title: binder v0 document record
description: One entry of documents[] in a binder v0 catalog. The file lives at path, inside the binder folder. Single source of the document_v0 copies. Unknown fields are allowed and preserved.

id.$comment: A v0 id is a non-empty string or a non-zero integer, compared by JSON type and value (section 5.6). Ids are copied with their type.

path.$comment: Relative to the binder folder. A record found at adoption may hold any path and is reported; a path written by file_document or update_document follows safe_path or record_path in op.schema.json.

client.description: program/version of the implementation that applied or proposed the op. The via of any log entry the op writes is copied from it.

origin.description: For kind external: where the change came from when known, for example spool-outbox, lifeproj or unknown.

reopened_from.$comment: A v0 id is a non-empty string or a non-zero integer, compared by JSON type and value (section 5.6). Ids are copied with their type.

refiled_from.$comment: The record whose unfile_document an Undo reversed (section 6.10). Copied with its JSON type.

from_document.$comment: The record's id in the source binder, with its JSON type.

transfer.$comment: On a record a transfer filed: the transfer, the source binder's binder_id (section 7.2.2) and the record's id there (section 6.9).
